from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shlex
import shutil
import statistics
import subprocess

root = Path('/home/ubuntu/workspace/mysrc/fireball')
runner = root / 'experiments/pysim/benchmarks/aobench/bench_native_build.py'
output = root / 'experiments/pysim/benchmarks/results/native_frame_pointer_ab_20261012.json'
work = Path('/tmp/fireball-frame-pointer-ab')
work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
compiler = shutil.which('clang++')
assert compiler
env_base = os.environ.copy()
env_base['UV_CACHE_DIR'] = '/tmp/fireball-uv-cache'
locations = ('tier2_runtime/interpreter', 'tier3_plugins/jit')
libraries = (
    root / 'experiments/pysim/tier2_runtime/interpreter/libnative_interpreter.so',
    root / 'experiments/pysim/tier3_plugins/jit/libtrace_compiler.so',
)
variants = {
    'omit': ['-fomit-frame-pointer'],
    'keep': ['-fno-omit-frame-pointer', '-mno-omit-leaf-frame-pointer'],
}
paths = sorted(p for tree in ('native', 'tier2_runtime', 'tier3_plugins', 'tier1_core')
               for p in (root / 'experiments/pysim' / tree).rglob('*')
               if p.suffix in ('.cxx', '.hxx', '.S', '.sh', '.py'))
paths.extend(root / p for p in ('tools/jit_stencil_gen/generate_assembly.py',
    'tools/jit_stencil_gen/abi_probe.cxx', 'experiments/pysim/benchmarks/aobench/bench_native_build.py',
    'experiments/pysim/benchmarks/aobench/aobench.wasm'))
def digest(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

source_hashes = {str(p.relative_to(root)): digest(p) for p in paths}
report = {
    'started_at': datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),
    'cpu_affinity': 2, 'widths': [64, 320], 'trials': 3, 'warmup': 3, 'repeats': 7,
    'compiler': subprocess.check_output([compiler, '--version'], text=True).splitlines()[0],
    'source_sha256': source_hashes,
    'common_flags': ['-O3', '-DNDEBUG', '-flto=thin', '-fuse-ld=lld'],
    'driver_source': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    'variant_builds': {}, 'processes': [], 'summary': [],
}
try:
    for variant, flags in variants.items():
        variant_dir = work / variant
        variant_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        wrapper = variant_dir / 'clang++'
        wrapper.write_text('#!/usr/bin/env bash\nexec ' + shlex.quote(compiler)
                           + ' "$@" ' + shlex.join(flags) + '\n')
        wrapper.chmod(0o755)
        env = env_base.copy()
        env['PATH'] = str(variant_dir) + os.pathsep + env['PATH']
        for location in locations:
            subprocess.run(['bash', str(root / 'experiments/pysim/native' / location / 'build_native.sh'),
                            '--release'], cwd=root, env=env, check=True)
        for library in libraries:
            shutil.copyfile(library, variant_dir / library.name)
        probe = subprocess.run([compiler, '-###', '-O3', *flags, '-c',
            str(root / 'experiments/pysim/native/tier2_runtime/interpreter/native_interpreter.cxx')],
            text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=True).stderr
        mode = next(word for word in shlex.split(probe) if word.startswith('-mframe-pointer='))
        assert mode == ('-mframe-pointer=none' if variant == 'omit' else '-mframe-pointer=all')
        disassembly = subprocess.check_output(['objdump', '-d', '--disassemble=fb_native_run_dispatch',
                                               str(libraries[0])], text=True)
        stencil_dir = Path('/tmp/fireball-pysim-native/jit-stencils')
        stencil_hashes = {p.name: digest(p) for p in sorted(stencil_dir.glob('*.bin'))}
        report['variant_builds'][variant] = {
            'final_flags': flags, 'clang_frame_pointer_mode': mode,
            'library_sha256': {library.name: digest(library) for library in libraries},
            'library_bytes': {library.name: library.stat().st_size for library in libraries},
            'dispatcher_disassembly': disassembly, 'stencil_sha256': stencil_hashes,
        }
    assert report['variant_builds']['omit']['stencil_sha256'] == report['variant_builds']['keep']['stencil_sha256']
    for width in (64, 320):
        for trial in range(3):
            order = ('omit', 'keep') if trial % 2 == 0 else ('keep', 'omit')
            for variant in order:
                for library in libraries:
                    shutil.copyfile(work / variant / library.name, library)
                for engine in (('interpreter', 'jit') if trial % 2 == 0 else ('jit', 'interpreter')):
                    row = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([
                        'taskset', '-c', '2', str(root / '.venv/bin/python'), str(runner),
                        '--engine', engine, '--width', str(width), '--warmup', '3', '--repeats', '7'
                    ], cwd=root, env=env_base, text=True))
                    row['variant'] = variant
                    row['trial'] = trial + 1
                    assert row['interpreter_library_sha256'] == report['variant_builds'][variant]['library_sha256'][libraries[0].name]
                    assert row['jit_library_sha256'] == report['variant_builds'][variant]['library_sha256'][libraries[1].name]
                    report['processes'].append(row)
                    print(f"{width}x{row['height']} trial={trial+1} {variant}/{engine}: {row['median_ms']:.3f} ms", flush=True)
        rows = [row for row in report['processes'] if row['width'] == width]
        assert len(rows) == 12 and len({row['frame_sha256'] for row in rows}) == 1
        for engine in ('interpreter', 'jit'):
            grouped = {variant: [row['median_ms'] for row in rows if row['variant']==variant and row['engine']==engine]
                       for variant in variants}
            medians = {variant: statistics.median(values) for variant, values in grouped.items()}
            report['summary'].append({
                'width': width, 'height': width * 9 // 16, 'engine': engine, 'median_ms': medians,
                'process_median_range_ms': {variant: [min(values), max(values)] for variant, values in grouped.items()},
                'omit_time_reduction_percent': (1 - medians['omit'] / medians['keep']) * 100,
                'keep_omit_ratio': medians['keep'] / medians['omit'], 'frame_sha256': rows[0]['frame_sha256'],
            })
    assert source_hashes == {str(p.relative_to(root)): digest(p) for p in paths}
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(report['summary'], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), flush=True)
    print('saved', output, flush=True)
finally:
    for location in locations:
        subprocess.run(['bash', str(root / 'experiments/pysim/native' / location / 'build_native.sh')],
                       cwd=root, env=env_base, check=True)
    print('Normal assertion-enabled builds restored', flush=True)
